policies: Sights include: Duluth Aerial Lift Bridge, Lake Superior (weather permitting), Great Lakes Tugboat Fleet, and Historic Grain Elevators.
Weather permitting, cruise goes through the Superior entry and Duluth canal.
If you cancel within 24 hours from the tour time no exchange, cash or credit refunds will be given.
What To Wear: Wear whatever will make you the most comfortable while paddle boarding, given the weather conditions of the day.
You must cancel your rental reservation within 48 hours before your scheduled kayak/paddleboard rental to receive a partial refund.
If you have a group (more than two vessels) reserved you must cancel AT LEAST 1 week in advance to receive a partial refund.
If there is a weather related issue on the day of your rental that causes us to be closed, we can reschedule your reservation or issue a refund.
